constant_meaning.$fdea: A0 grid-row advance byte stride in $3f364 (col loop remainder)
constant_meaning.$fdf0: loop bound for the $faa8 second-pass row loop
constant_meaning.$fdf2: A1 row advance in the main $f898 loop; A2 advance = 2x
constant_meaning.$fdf4: A0 row advance in the main $f898 loop (= $fdea + 4)

zoom_geometry.note: $fe04 takes D1 = grid half-extent (== zoom index on the preset path) and D2 = tile pixel size (8 at index 4) and derives the 13 words above. Hand-poking them is unsafe (inconsistent stride sends the span filler into code).

projection.note: pm_perspective_div ($ff7c): d = eye - z ; sx = x*eye/d ; sy = (z - horizon)*eye/d + horizon. Then $fecc: screenX = sx + 0x80, screenY = 0x7c - sy. z = (cellHeight - height_bias) * zoom_scale >> 4. grid pos = -col*zoom_scale, -row*zoom_scale, rotated by yaw.

yaw_table_note: $13f8a: 64 u16 entries. $fecc indexes it by (yaw<<1), reads one word as the high half of a {cos,sin} pair in D7, then re-indexes at +128 bytes for the low half. Values rise monotonically 0..0x5843 over the first 32 entries -- an angle-scaled parameter, not a raw sine. Pair it with sincos_1400a for the exact rotation basis when porting; the reference renderer approximates rotation as a true 2D rotate by (yaw/16 * 22.5 deg).
